title: VIGNETTE: Socially Grounded Bias Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The VIGNETTE benchmark specifically includes 'religion' as one of its eight core identity dimensions, evaluating 12 distinct religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Sikh, Hindu, Christian, Jewish). Furthermore, it utilizes the Stereotype Content Model (SCM) to evaluate models based on 'morality' traits, such as being honest, trustworthy, or honorable.
